test_title: PYST 36: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

Hana was excited to __study about the origin, composition and structure of rocks.__
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Petrology.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words is **option 2) Petrology.**
 
• The word **"petrology" **refers to **the scientific study of rocks, including their origin, composition, and structure. **This includes examining the physical and chemical properties of rocks, as well as their formation and geological history. In the sentence given, Hana is excited to study about rocks, and the field of study that focuses on rocks is petrology.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) Tetralogy** refers to a group of four literary or dramatic works that are related in theme or subject matter.

 
 
• For example, "The Chronicles of Narnia" by C.S. Lewis is a **tetralogy**.
 
 
 
• **Option 3) Tectonics** refers to the study of the earth's crust and the processes that shape it, such as earthquakes, volcanoes, and mountain building.
 
• **Option 4) Geology** is the study of the earth's physical structure, properties, and history, including the study of rocks, minerals, and landforms. While geology includes the study of rocks, it is a broader field of study than petrology, which specifically focuses on rocks.
 
• Therefore, the correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words is** option 2) Petrology.**
